scientific_integrity: Finite computations are corroborations; the all-parameter theorem follows from exact binary linear algebra, rank-nullity and character sums. The discovery and originality assessment is not an independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only open-neighborhood adjacency parity, not closed-neighborhood parity
Only two-token graphs of complete bipartite graphs with both sides of size at least two
Older unindexed coding-theoretic equivalents may exist
title: Binary open-neighborhood parity codes of biclique two-token graphs
